Hi Ana, I'm sorry I can't offer a bank transfer. Late-delivery credits are never paid out in cash. They're applied to your Northwind account instead.

For NW1001, the Express shipment was promised by 2026-11-03 and was delivered on 2026-11-05, so it was late. That qualifies for a 100% credit of the shipping fee, applied to your account within 7 days. The credit doesn't apply if the delay was caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address supplied by the customer. Based on the records I have, neither applies.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
